title: What will the announcers say during the Ravens vs Cowboys game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official CBS announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Baltimore Ravens vs Dallas Cowboys game on CBS, scheduled for September 27, 2026 at 4:25 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "CBS announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national CBS telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official CBS announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Baltimore Ravens vs Dallas Cowboys game on CBS, scheduled for September 27, 2026 at 4:25 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "CBS announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national CBS telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf
